_comment: Hand-labeled corrections fixture set, the G1 instrument for the memory-recurrence mine (docs/ideation/memory-recurrence/spec-phase-1.md). Labels are human-made; this file changes only deliberately, with the reason recorded in the change itself, mirroring the frozen-corpus discipline in docs/EVAL.md and src/eval/corpus.ts. Each entry is { text, label: 'correction' | 'not', source }; `source` is a one-line note on where the phrasing shape came from. Entries must stay in the 25-240 char band (or deliberately out of it for band tests) and corrections must not be question-shaped, or the label stops meaning what recall.test.ts asserts.
